implementation: SafeZone FIPS Cryptographic Module Option C
description: SafeZone FIPS Cryptographic Module is a FIPS 140-2 Security Level 1 validated software cryptographic module from INSIDE Secure. The module is a toolkit which provides the most commonly needed cryptographic primitives for a large variety of applications, including but not limited to, primitives for DAR, DRM, TLS, and VPN on mobile devices.
